content.title: This Power-Plant Builder Jumps To Record High On AI Tailwinds
content.summary: Argan stock jumped to an all-time high Monday after a JPMorgan Chase upgrade that called the heavy construction company an underappreciated piece of the AI buildout.  JPMorgan raised Argan to overweight from neutral and lifted the price target to 315 from 220.  Argan and subsidiary Gemma Power Systems are underappreciated beneficiaries of the accelerating demand for electricity to power artificial intelligence applications, TheFly.com quoted from the JPMorgan report.

content.title: Tripadvisor, Argan And This Stock Touch New Highs, Buy Points
content.summary: As the major stock indexes reached new heights Friday, Tripadvisor and Argan joined the stock market's advance and touched new highs.  Tripadvisor stock reached a level not seen since May 2024, and Argan shares have increased fivefold since their March 2024 base breakout.  Tripadvisor broke out of a flat base with a 19.26 buy point Friday but the breakout faded.
